svg.text: Fixed-wing: effects depend on the dataset
Added arm − Baseline · flight-macro MAE (s) · mean across three seeds
Intervals: paired date-cluster bootstrap, 2,000 resamples; no multiplicity correction.
Seed variability is not included. Separate panel scales; ALFA primary n=1 is not inferential.
